node_hours_per_run.counted_over: every run that consumed node time in the window — the census, the 4x-budget study and the transfer — not the census alone. Dividing by the census charges the whole campaign to it.

why_allocation_not_process_time: Azure bills a node from allocation to release, which includes pulling the training image, mounting the corpus, and the scale-down window. None of that appears in wall_clock_seconds, and across thousands of short jobs it is a forty per cent difference. Every quote this project made before this measurement was low by it.
why_not_from_the_bill: Cost Management returns zero cost and zero usage for this subscription. It is sponsored and the consumption data sits at the billing-account scope, so no billed figure was available to reconcile against.
measured_until: Platform metrics are retained 93 days, after which this cannot be recomputed from any source. That is why it is an artifact.
